title: Patch: Arcane Missiles never aims at a Unit immune to Spells, and Unlicensed Experimentation and an Embiggened Transmogulate leave Dormant cards alone
notes: R4424000: Arcane Missiles draws each missile from cards_in_scope, Unlicensed Experimentation matches no Dormant card in when or run, and an Embiggened Transmogulate leaves Dormant board cards out of its walk; the scripts of v0.6.9i are kept (script_v0_6_9i)

player.title: Dormant cards and spell-immune Units keep what is theirs
fixes: Arcane Missiles no longer aims at Units immune to Spells.
Unlicensed Experimentation leaves Dormant cards alone.
An Embiggened Transmogulate leaves Dormant cards as they are.
